pipeline.title: 6-Step Satellite Processing Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: How Prakriti-Netra converts raw Copernicus open data into actionable field alerts
pipeline.status: Pipeline Status: Active (Last pass processed 4 hours ago)
pipeline.step1Desc: Poll Copernicus Open Data Space API for new Sentinel-2 MSI and Sentinel-1 SAR passes covering Kudremukh tile 43PGK.
pipeline.step2Desc: Apply Cloud & Snow mask using SCL band (Scene Classification) to eliminate false shadows from monsoon clouds.
pipeline.step3Desc: Compute bi-temporal differential NDVI (ΔNDVI = NDVI_T2 - NDVI_T1) and SAR co-polarization backscatter shift.
pipeline.step4Desc: Eliminate sub-pixel noise and seasonal deciduous fluctuations using spatial morphology filters (> 0.5 hectare min area).
pipeline.step5Desc: Machine learning model predicts anomaly class: illegal clearing, fire scar, seasonal shedding, or residual cloud error.
pipeline.step6Desc: Publish geocoded alert with centroid GPS, confidence rating, and dispatch push notification to forest guard Telegram bot.
